reason: We run fees in Tally and notices on WhatsApp and it works well enough. I won't move my school's data to a new company I've never heard of until I've seen it running at a school like ours. Even at half price, Rs 35,400 with GST is over my Rs 25,000 limit, so it would have to go to the chairman.
objection: Nobody I know uses it. I don't know if my office staff and parents will actually use it, or if the company will still be around next year with our fee records.
would_change_my_mind: Visiting a nearby CBSE school of our size that has used it for a full session and hearing from their accountant that fee collection and the parent app really work.
